Subject: Finalize MAP — signature windows, approvals, and Day 1 landing

Alex — attaching the mutual action plan (MAP) and a lightweight signoff checklist so Procurement & Legal can see the final gating items. High level:

- Requested final signoff window: target week of May 10 (preferred) or May 17 as backup.
- Key approvals we need from Zephyr: Procurement, IT Security (SOC2 confirmation), and the Business Sponsor (Elaine).
- Paperwork: we will send a DocuSign packet for EULA + SOW; Legal redlines need to be in by Friday 4/30 to hit the May 10 window.

Ask: please confirm the signer list and whether Procurement needs a PO before DocuSign. If May 10 is tight, tell us the earliest feasible Day 1 start and we’ll try to carve a pilot-start earlier (partial ramp).

Attachments: MAP-Zephyr-Redwood-20270422.xlsx (MAP with milestone dates)

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126
From: Alex Burns <aburns@zephyrretail.com>

Cc: procurement@zephyrretail.com, Elaine Park <e.park@zephyrretail.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalize MAP — signature windows, approvals, and Day 1 landing

Ben — thanks for the plan and the clear asks. Quick answers: 

- Signer list: Elaine Park (Business Sponsor), Mark Holt (CFO approval), and Procurement (procurement@zephyrretail.com). IT Security will validate SOC2 artifacts but the security approver is Darren Lin (cc'ed on the procurement alias).
- PO: yes, Procurement prefers a PO on file before executing the DocuSign envelope. That will push us a week; earliest realistic start is the week of May 17.
- Redlines: Legal is short-staffed this week — if you can push the SOW and EULA by Monday we’ll try to turn redlines in by 4/30 but cannot promise.

Prefer we keep a single DocuSign packet for signature routing (Elaine -> Mark -> Procurement). If Redwood can accept a staged Day 1 (pilot account enabling for 1 team) on May 13, that helps our onboarding schedule while Procurement completes the PO.

Alex
Head of Integrations | Zephyr Retail
aburns@zephyrretail.com

Subject: Re: Finalize MAP — signature windows, approvals, and Day 1 landing

Alex — got it, appreciate the clarity. Triage plan: 

1) I’ll issue the DocuSign packet Monday AM (EULA + SOW + SOW appendix for pilot).
2) Kimberly/Legal will accept redlines up to 4/30; beyond that we may need to agree on a narrow carve for pilot metrics.
3) We can enable a limited pilot environment for one product squad on May 13 (provisional access) with the formal enterprise Day 1 set for May 17 once Procurement confirms the PO.

I’ll include a separate signature packet that lists the exact routing (Elaine -> Mark -> procurement@zephyrretail.com). Also included a short signature pack (attachment) with the onboarding statement and acceptance checklist — that should help Procurement speed the PO.

One ask from our side: for the pilot to begin May 13 we need security to confirm the SOC2 artifact access by 5/3. Prioym — can your team queue the artifact link and a brief walkthrough session for Darren?

Ben

Alex / Elaine — following up with the formal go/no-go checklist and the final timing for signatures. Please see the plan below and confirm by end-of-day Tuesday 4/27 if the routing and dates are accepted.

Final go/no-go checklist (required by 17:00 PT on 2027-04-26):
- Procurement confirms PO timeline and primary contact (procurement@zephyrretail.com) — REQUIRED
- Business Sponsor (Elaine) confirms Day 1 product scope and pilot roster — RECOMMENDED
- IT Security confirms SOC2 artifact access and a 30-minute walkthrough with Darren — RECOMMENDED but required for pilot enablement
- Redlines to Legal in DocuSign package must be submitted by 2027-04-30 to preserve the May 10/17 cadence

Signature routing (DocuSign packet): Elaine Park -> Mark Holt (CFO) -> procurement@zephyrretail.com. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/rooms/zz-8237-accept

If Procurement needs a PO before signing we accept a staged execution: pilot access May 13 (limited) and enterprise go-live May 17 after PO is posted.

Ben will send the DocuSign packet Monday morning. Prioym, please confirm the SOC2 artifact link by Thursday 5/03 so we can enable pilot.

Thanks —
